title: GIT_New
description: The map includes layers of  interest to landowners and to others interested in parcels.  Some layers occur twice.  One occurrence will illustrate the boundaries of the features and dynamically label the features.  The other occurrence will uniquely color each feature in the layer and the features can be identified by referring to the legend or by also turning on the corresponding labeled boundary layer.
snippet: GIT is aimed at providing landowners and others with information about parcels.
